{{Quote|Goldie, shut these droids down!''"<br />"''I'm afraid Arthree is a little ''slow'' on the uptake.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker, after R3-S6 activates the pair of IG-86 sentinel droids|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
The '''Ambush on the ''Vulture's Claw''''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the opening [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], attempted to recover the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] had gone missing during the previous [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], so Skywalker and Tano set out aboard the [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] and ventured to the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] last known location: [[Golm|Bothawui Prime's]] [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]]. While scouring the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], they happened upon the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt's]] [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|salvage ship]], the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], and boarded it disguised as peasant customers. Nachkt showed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to his wares, but after Skywalker's replacement [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]]&mdash;who was secretly a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;activated a pair of [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]] within the cargo hold, Skywalker and Tano were forced into combat with the [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. After dismantling [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid 1/Legends|their]] [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid 2/Legends|assailants]], the Jedi left the ''Vulture's Claw'' empty-handed, remaining unaware that Nachkt had salvaged R2-D2 and promised the droid to Grievous.

==Prelude==
{{Dialogue|Kenobi|<nowiki></nowiki>''What?'' He's still programmed with our tactics and base locations? If the Separatists get a hold of him&hellip; What possessed you not to erase that droid's memory?|Tano|Master Obi-Wan, sometimes Artoo having that extra information has come in handy.|Kenobi|Well, then find that droid, Anakin. Our necks might very well depend on it.|Skywalker|Right away, Master.|attr=Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano, and Anakin Skywalker, on R2-D2|audio=WhatPossessedYouNotToEraseThatDroidsMemory-DownfallOfADroid.flac|src=<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Date" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] marshaled a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in [[Space warfare/Legends|defense]] of the strategic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], which was being targeted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> In the ensuing [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]],<ref name="TCW Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Grievous's [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] suffered critical losses, prompting the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general to flee from the battlefield with Skywalker in hot [[Starfighter combat/Legends|pursuit]]. However, shrapnel spawned by the disintegrating Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigates]] wrecked Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]], which consequently veered into the [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]]<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm|Bothawui Prime]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Although [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," rescued Skywalker from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], |he was unable to save Skywalker's [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Skywalker had developed an attachment to R2-D2 and, as a result, had never [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiped]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Memory bank/Legends|memory]], which was thus full of classified [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] data.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

[[File:Anakins_Delta-7B_wreckage.png|thumb|left|250px|The wreckage of Skywalker's Delta-7B interceptor in Bothawui Prime's asteroid belt]]
When [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] learned of Skywalker's dilemma, he ordered him and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to find and retrieve R2-D2, as the information within his databanks would prove fatal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] if it fell into Confederate hands. As Skywalker and Tano prepared to depart from their [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], aboard Skywalker's personal [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], they were issued a replacement droid: [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]] with more powerful capabilities than R2-D2's model.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> However, both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were unaware that R3-S6 was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and enemy agent working for Grievous, intent on removing Skywalker as an obstacle for the cyborg general.<ref name="Duel of the Droids">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref> Also unbeknownst to the Jedi, the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] salvaged R2-D2 from the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and offered the droid to Grievous, who in return promised Nachkt a number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Nachkt concealed R2-D2 in a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] compartment aboard his<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]],<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']].<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" />

Weaving through the battlefield debris amidst Bothawui Prime's asteroids, Skywalker and Tano spotted the former's [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]]. Yet the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech socket]] was empty, and though Skywalker believed that R2-D2 had escaped, Tano failed to locate the droid on the ''Twilight''{{'s}} scanners. They caught sight of the ''Vulture's Claw'' and decided to board the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to see if the scavenger had recovered R2-D2. After docking with the ''Vulture's Claw'',<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> Skywalker and Tano donned simple [[Robe/Legends|robes]] to disguise themselves as peasants,<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> then boarded the craft with R3-S6. Upon greeting his new customers, Nachkt lied and told them that he had not picked up any R2 units for a long [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> as war shortages had made the [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] scarce.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> When Skywalker flashed a handful of shiny credits, the greedy Nachkt amended his statement with a smile and told the disguised Jedi that there might be an R2 unit buried in the depths of his cargo hold. He allowed Skywalker, Tano, and R3-S6 to browse through his wares there, warning them to be careful of his "unique items" before leaving.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

==The ambush==
{{Quote|You were right about the hands-on experience, gramps. ''Much'' better than the Archives.''"<br />"''Good job, but you missed one.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker, shortly before the latter destroys the final sentinel droid|audio=HandsOnExperience-DoaD.flac|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
[[File:Ahsoka_dodges_droids.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker and Tano grapple with the sentinel droids in the cargo hold.]]
After a short time, Tano found the unique items of which Nachkt had spoken: a pair of [[Death/Legends|deadly]] but inactive [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]], which were connected to the ship's systems via cables. As they continued to peruse Nachkt's inventory, Skywalker ordered R3-S6 to access the ship's [[Cargo manifest/Legends|cargo manifest]] to see if any droids matching R2-D2's description were logged. Suddenly, they heard a sound that Skywalker concluded was R2-D2's trademark whistle, and he bolted over to a nearby [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] from which the sound had originated. Although Tano was skeptical of whether it had been R2-D2, Skywalker told R3-S6 to open the door, but the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] instead flashed on the cargo hold's lights. Exasperated with R3-S6's apparent ineptitude, Skywalker activated his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and began to cut through the door himself.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

At that moment, R3-S6 switched on the dormant IG-86 sentinel droids, [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid 1/Legends|one]] of which grabbed Tano from behind. On hearing his Padawan's cry of surprise, Skywalker came to her aid, [[Dismemberment/Legends|slicing off]] the [[Limb/Legends|arm]] of the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] holding Tano and then using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] push both droids into a pile of crates. Tano told R3-S6 to shut down the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] droids, but before R3-S6 could do so, the two droids released themselves from the ship's cables. As the sentinel droids targeted the Jedi with their [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]], Skywalker and Tano deflected the oncoming [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], though their agile adversaries summarily launched themselves onto the adjacent shelves. Skywalker and Tano soon managed to knock them back to ground level, but Tano's one-armed opponent shoved a crate in her direction, pinning her against the shelf behind her. Before the sentinel droid could incapacitate Skywalker from behind, Tano jumped to her Master's aid, cleanly slicing the droid in half with her [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]]. Skywalker took care of the [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid 2/Legends|second assassin droid]], [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] it with a single lightsaber strike.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You'll be sorry you ever came aboard my ship, Jedi. I'm about to make your life ''miserable''.|Gha Nachkt, as he contacts Grievous following the Jedi's departure|audio=ImAboutToMakeYourLifeMiserable-DownfallOfADroid.flac|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
[[File:Anakins_Delta-7B_hyperdrive_ring.png|thumb|left|230px|Skywalker embarks on his next mission in his Delta-7B interceptor.]]
Following the ambush, Skywalker rounded on R3-S6, criticizing the astromech droid's deficiency; R3-S6 responded by finally opening the nearby blast door. In the room on the other side was a surprised Nachkt. Activating his lightsaber, Skywalker threateningly questioned the scavenger regarding the whereabouts of R2-D2, but Tano convinced her Master that the missing droid was not aboard the ''Vulture's Claw''. Still irate, Skywalker shoved past Nachkt, and Tano and R3-S6 followed him back onto the ''Twilight''. Before the Jedi detached from his ship, Nachkt called after them that they owed him for the mess&mdash;the butchered sentinel droids&mdash;that they had left behind. Shortly thereafter, Nackht [[holograph]]ically contacted Grievous and informed him that he was en route to rendezvous with him and deliver R2-D2. Although Nachkt attempted to negotiate a higher payment since R2-D2 was obviously valuable to the Jedi, he acquiesced when Grievous did not respond positively to his haggling.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

Meanwhile, after hearing Skywalker's report of his failure to find R2-D2, Kenobi told him that they had to assume the droid had been destroyed in the explosion that had claimed Skywalker's starfighter.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> Skywalker then contacted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and declared R2-D2 officially lost in action. Believing that his fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]&mdash;including the ''Resolute''&mdash;could use some modifications, Skywalker took them back to the [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] where they had been constructed to refit them.<ref name="Wild Space" /> Eventually, Kenobi contacted Skywalker to relay his next assignment. Republic intelligence had confirmed the existence of a Confederate [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], and Skywalker and Tano were to find and destroy it before it could intercept further Republic transmissions.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> Skywalker decided to personally scour the outer corridors of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was suspected of Separatist activity,<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> while Tano and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex maintained a more central path with the ''Resolute'' and the remainder of their forces. Once his starfighter had been retrieved and repaired, Skywalker departed on his [[Mission to suspected Confederate space/Legends|new mission]] with R3-S6.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Dialogue|Skywalker|I regret to inform you, and the Jedi Council, that during the Bothawui engagement with Grievous I lost my Artoo unit. And that, despite an extensive and exhaustive search, I have been unable to locate him. Therefore I must declare Artoo-Detoo officially lost in action.|Yoda|Unfortunate this news is, young Skywalker. A valuable asset your droid was.|Skywalker|Yes, Master Yoda. I know that. I am deeply sorry I've failed to find him.|Windu|Anakin, what's done is done. You'll be assigned a new droid as soon as possible. In the meantime we have a war to conduct.|attr=A conversation between Anakin Skywalker, Yoda, and Mace Windu in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' disrupts the episode's continuity|src=<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
[[File:Ahsoka_vs_sentinel.png|thumb|right|240px|Tano fights the one-armed sentinel droid.]]
The Ambush on the ''Vulture's Claw''<ref name="Hasbro: Vulture's Claw">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Ambush on the ''Vulture's Claw''|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWBPVulturesClaw.asp}}</ref> was created as part of the storyline of "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The episode aired on [[November 7]], [[2008]].<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> Besides being mentioned in various supplementary material for the series,<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /><ref name="TCW Visual Guide" /> the event was made into a [[Hasbro]] Battle Pack entitled [https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWBPVulturesClaw.asp Ambush on the ''Vulture's Claw''], which provided the event with a name.<ref name="Hasbro: Vulture's Claw" />

The [[December]] 2008 novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', which made reference to Skywalker's unsuccessful search for R2-D2, introduced some [[Canon|continuity]] problems surrounding the event. The novel stated that after their unsuccessful search, Skywalker and Tano returned to the [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen Six]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], and they embarked on their sweeps of suspected Confederate space at the end of the book.<ref name="Wild Space" /> This contradicted the events of the episode, in which the Ambush on the ''Vulture's Claw'' was immediately followed by Skywalker's mission to suspected Confederate space.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> Furthermore, the novel erroneously stated that R3-S6 was not assigned to Skywalker until after his fruitless search for R2-D2,<ref name="Wild Space" /> even though R3-S6 had already been issued to Skywalker prior to the episode's events aboard the ''Vulture's Claw''.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> This article assumes that the novel's interpretation of events is correct aside from the chronology error regarding R3-S6's issuance to Skywalker.
